title: The box was fun and engaging!
text: I enjoyed the experience until I tried to access the website… which does not allow me to connect my subscription to my account. When attempting to connect with customer service, it says response time is a few hours… so I guess there is a huge disconnect between the product and the customer opportunity to engage. It’s the right idea and the right product and the right experience…. Until you want to actually do something with it.
label: neutral
